notes.title: New DLC：Ring Mode（擂台争霸）
notes.content:
Hello，everyone.
After a lapse of one month, we brought you a brand new DLC: Ring Mode（擂台争霸）.

[h1]About this DLC [/h1]
This DLC contains the brand-new Ring Mode.
You will experience what’s it like to be immortal in this mode and enjoy the fun of using your card deck to defeat strong opponents.
What’s more, there are three new equips and six new achievements in this mode for you to obtain.
After unlocking them, you can receive the special support from western heroes in Adventure Mode.
The new DLC will be discounted 10% in the first week.

[h1]Update[/h1]
1.Adjust the effect of ‘Legion's Fist’, because the combination with ‘Greenfang Fist-Fighter’ will cause the battle to become monotonous.
2.Fix the bug that ‘Blood-Soul Lock’ only takes 1 round.
3.Fix the bug caused by ‘Stonemantle Fist-Master’
4.Correct the English discription of ‘Ghost Resurrection’
5.Fix the bug that "failed to get challenge information" when entering the challenge mode.

[h1]List of chievement ‘Riddler’[/h1]
451874735
Baronys
南MIO大王
SeasonIsland
Fognue
慕白喵
Kitkatony
骨釘大師
stu2733
Please contact customer service at steamgame@tanyu.mobi to receive new DLC activation code reward.

notes.title: Announcement
notes.content:
Dear Players~
     After this game update, we found that the old player updated the game and the archive progress was overwritten. In order to prevent more players from being affected, we temporarily backtrack the game version to avoid more players being affected. After the version is backtracked, the DLC will temporarily be unable to unlock. This problem will be solved after the BUG is fixed. Our technicians are working on this issue and we are very sorry for the inconvenience caused to the players.
        Players who have already downloaded the update can turn off the cloud archive sync of the game first, to avoid cloud archives being overwritten.
        If you have any questions, please contact: steamgame@tanyu.mobi

notes.title: Full Release available now
notes.content:
Thanks for your support and feedback during our EA version!

[h1][b]The full release version is available now![/b][/h1]

Here is the description for our works during these period 

[h1]What we did from EA to now[/h1]
[olist]
    [*]Add some maps, background music and dubbing(Chinese)
    [*]Add some missions, events and merchant
    [*]Add chat system for NPC
    [*]Add some simple terrain elements
    [*]Add Card Pool system, players could decide which cards will occur in this game and provide recommend Card Pool for new players
    [*]Add Two-step verification 
    [*]Optimize and modify the animation of battle and modify mechanism of some skills
    [*]Re-design the Path of Fate, Now Path of Fate will tell a short story to make players have a better experience. Additionally, it is more easy for veterans to choose a map that they want.
    [*]Fix numerous bugs
[/olist]

[h1]What full release version will have[/h1]
[olist]
    [*]The third hero Galamer
    [*]Hard difficulty level for each hero
    [*]True end of each hero
    [*]Challenge mode
    [*]Modify the consume and product of Shredded Paper, now it is much easier to unlock cards
[/olist]

[h1]What we will do in the future[/h1]
[olist]
    [*]Add more dubbing before 25/4/2019
    [*]Keep optimize the experience of the game
    [*]Start to design new content
    [*]Add mac version for Steam
[/olist]

[h1]The price of full release will up to $ 17.99[/h1]

[h1][b]Additionally, the Papercraft will be published on iOS on  4/25/2019 [/b][/h1][olist]
    [*]Now Papercraft can be Pre-ordered on App store
    [*]Unfortunately, data cannot be shared by different platform.
    [*]There will be a set of commemoration appearance for each hero for Steam players（you will get it on 4.12）
[/olist]

notes.title: Update 2019/03/13
notes.content:
[b]New function[/b]

1.Path of Fate

The old one(Answer three questions and draw on card to decide which map you will go) often make player confused, we re-design this part.
Now Path of Fate will tell a short story to make players have a better experience. Additionally, it is more easy for veterans to choose a map that they want.

2.Chat System

Now players could chat with the enemy.
In on hand, Chat System could provide some elemental information or skills for this game, in the other hand, Chat System will provide some additional plots of the game.

3.New Special Land 

In boss fight, we add some special terrain on the map, hoping they could make the fight more interesting.

4.Two-step verification of each move.

This is aiming at decrease the mistake operation of players, it could be closed/opened in Setting.

Bug Fix

1.Fix the bug caused by the option of Travelling Merchant
2.Fix the bug that Travelling Merchant and Smith's could be used unlimited.
3.Fix the bug that Travelling Merchant could be refreshed unlimited.
4.Fix the card Smash! cannot be used.
5.Fix the bug that Achievement Exhaust Recources cannot be finished.
6.Fix the bug that Achievement Adventure Lover cannot be finished.
7.Fix the bug that the EXP of the role will be negative in high-level teach mode.
8.Fix the bug that some corner cannot be reached in snow map.

notes.title: Update 2019/03/07
notes.content:
1.Add Card Pool system. Now players could decide which cards could appear of each game.
*The number of total cards of each hero is much more than players really need to finish a game so that the relationship between the  number of unlocked card and the experience of each game is not positive. As a consequence, we provide a system that each players could custom their own card pool of each game. For those who is unfamiliar with this game, we also provide some recommendation Card Pool. This system is still under polishing, we will keep collecting feedback and make it better in the future.

*At first we hope that players could unlock about 1/4 cards of total cards to get best experience of the game, yet we notice that it is inconsistent with players' habit and many players think that it is exhausting to get card unlocked. Accompanied with the Card Pool system, we adjust the difficulty of unlock new card.

2.Add new teach levels that could help players learn about the skills in adventure 

3.Add new NPC, Wandering Merchant, he could provide some convenient services, in some price, of course.

4.Add a series of achievement about the main story.

5.Add the Guild of paper 

6.Add standby action for each hero on exploration map.

7.Fix the description error of "Final Strength"

notes.title: Update 2019/2/20
notes.content:
Add：
1.Add 2 New maps in snow field.
2.Players now could sort their draw deck according to the kind of cards
3.Add the closed symbol of some closed buildings(Mercenaries Guild, Smith's)
4.Add more resolution mode.
5.Add some new background music in some Queen's scene.

Optimize:
1.Optimize and modify the animation of battle and modify mechanism of some skills and modify the Normal level 4 and Hard level 27 in riddle mode.
2.The button "Return" change to "Save and return"
3.Accelerate most of animation in the game.
4.Optimize window mode.
Fix:
1.Fix the bug that in the battle with Greenshade Apostle, enemies will keep reinforcing in to the battle.
2.Fix the bug that SMASH! can not stun the enemies in some situations.

[b]Modify the order of each fight, now enemies will beat back first and then calculate the result of the each fight. [/b]
*Many players said that enemies could beat back after they had dead is unreasonable, yet it is part of our design and dead enemies will not beat back will influence a lot about the balance of the game such as enlarge of the value of high ATK units and etc. We change the order of the animation of each fight, hope it could make this process more acceptable.
